Title: Python Dates
Description: A date in Python is not a data type of its own, but we can import a module named datetime.

Challenges.Title: Import datetime
Challenges.Exercise: Import the datetime module and print the current date using `.now()`.

Challenges.Title: Return year
Challenges.Exercise: Print the year of the current date.

Challenges.Title: Create date
Challenges.Exercise: Create a date object for 2020, 5, 17 using `datetime.datetime`.

Challenges.Title: Strftime
Challenges.Exercise: Print the name of the month using `strftime("%B")`.

Challenges.Title: Weekday
Challenges.Exercise: Print the weekday of the date using `strftime("%A")`.
